overview.goal: Find two or three Meta ads that sell Mornings and Nights at a cost we can scale, and have New Year creative live by 26 Dec.
overview.summary: Built from the Supply6 ad teardown (230 ads, 17 Nov) and our playbook. Their long-runners are creators talking to camera, symptom-first hooks, one proof number, and offer-led statics. We use the same formats with our own edge: two rituals, every dose printed, a lab report for each ingredient. Two in-house shoot days, one creator wave, four ad tests, three Instagram posts a week.
decisions: Monthly Meta budget and target cost per purchase. The testing rules below are written around that number.
Starter kit offer for the statics: a free bottle or frother with the Combo, a discount, or no offer. Needed by 30 Nov.
Creator budget: 3 to 4 creators, each with partnership-ad (whitelisting) access for 60 days.
New Year offer for 26 Dec to 5 Jan.
Owners for shoots, editing, statics and Ads Manager. Add them on each card below.
rules: New creatives go into a separate testing campaign: one ad set per concept, 3 to 5 creatives each, equal budget.
Judge after 3 days, or once an ad has spent about 2x the target cost per purchase, whichever comes first.
Video: pause if the 3-second hook rate is under 25% or link CTR is under 0.8% after about 2,000 impressions. These are starting thresholds; tighten them once we have our own averages.
Statics: pause if link CTR is under 0.8% after about 2,000 impressions.
Keep anything at or under target cost per purchase. Move keepers to the scaling campaign on Monday review days.
Never edit a live winner. Make an iteration (new first 3 seconds, same body) as a new ad.
Every new video concept gets 3 hook versions.
kpis: Hook rate (3-second views / impressions) and hold rate (ThruPlays / 3-second views)
Link CTR, cost per add to cart, cost per purchase, ROAS
Instagram: saves and shares per reel, quiz completions from the bio link
cadence: Monday: review last week's ads and check Supply6 Mellow for new ads

items.title: Shortlist and brief 4 creators
items.summary: 10 of Supply6's 15 longest-running videos are creators talking to a phone. We need people our buyer recognises: working professionals at a desk, not fitness influencers.
items.talent: Working professionals in Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR or Pune with 10k to 100k followers who post about work life, productivity or routines. At least one who speaks Hinglish on camera. Two for Mornings, two for Nights.
deliverables: One 35 to 45s video per creator, vertical 9:16, natural light, phone camera
3 extra versions of the first 3 seconds (different hook lines)
Raw footage and 5 product B-roll clips
Partnership-ad access to their handle for 60 days
Shoot by 4 Dec, deliver by 6 Dec
items.script:
Pick one hook, then say it in your own words.
Mornings hooks: "Between the 9 to 5, the gym and 10,000 steps, I quick-fix everything." / "My third coffee is at 3 PM. That's the problem." / "I read the label before I drink anything now."
Nights hooks: "My brain starts its shift when my laptop closes." / "I used to scroll till 1 AM. Now this is my cue to stop."

Must say (Mornings): 80 mg caffeine with 200 mg L-theanine, fibre and probiotics, every dose printed on the box.
Must say (Nights): 3 g glycine, the dose used in sleep studies, magnesium bisglycinate, KSM-66 ashwagandha, no melatonin.
Never say: cures, treats, fixes insomnia, improves sleep, clinically proven. No other brand names.
Show: stick into water, the label close up, the drink in your real day (desk, commute, bedside).

items.title: Shoot 1 (in-house): founder, skit, Nights video, lifestyle loops, stills
items.summary: One day, two sets. Morning: office desk. Evening: home. Produces the videos for Test 1 and two weeks of Instagram.
items.location: Office desk with window light (morning). A bedroom or living room with warm lamps (evening).
items.talent: Abhishek (founder video), one team member (skit, plays both parts), one team member or friend (Nights video)
shotlist: A. Founder talking head, 45s, eye level, desk behind. Record all 3 hooks, then the body twice.
B. Skit '3 PM crash': same person in two outfits, locked-off camera, both sides of the conversation.
C. Nights video: laptop closing, phone face down, kettle, stick into warm water, sip at the bedside. Talking head for the voiceover lines.
D. Lifestyle loops, no talking, 12 to 15s each: stick into a bottle at the desk at 9 AM, on the commute, before a call, Nights mug at the bedside at 11 PM.
E. Stills for statics: Mornings and Nights label close-ups with doses readable, lab reports fanned out, Combo box flat lay, kit with bottle (if the offer is on).
F. B-roll: pouring, stirring, the powder dissolving, hands opening the box, 10 clips of 5s.
items.script:
A. FOUNDER (45s)
Hooks: 1) "Why we didn't put sixty things in one sachet." 2) "I spent ten years at a desk before I made this." 3) "Every milligram in this stick is printed on the box. Here's why."
Body: "Before SILT I spent ten years in corporate. Mornings ran on coffee, nights ran on scrolling. When we built SILT we kept two rules. An ingredient goes in at the dose used in studies, or it doesn't go in. And every dose is printed on the pack, with a lab report for each ingredient. That's why there are two sticks. Mornings has 80 mg caffeine with 200 mg L-theanine, plus fibre and probiotics. Nights has 3 grams of glycine, magnesium bisglycinate and KSM-66 ashwagandha, with no melatonin. One in the morning, one at night. The lab reports are on our site."

B. SKIT '3 PM CRASH' (35 to 40s)
A: "It's 3 PM and I'm done." B: "Coffee?" A: "That would be number three." B: "What did you have this morning?" A: "Coffee. And a biscuit." B: "Start the day with this instead. SILT Mornings. 80 mg caffeine with 200 mg L-theanine, fibre, probiotics, B12 and D3." A: "That's it?" B: "One stick in water. Every dose is on the box." End card: SILT Mornings, about Rs 60 a day.

C. NIGHTS (35s)
Hook: "Laptop closed at 11. My brain didn't."
Body: "This is the part of the day nobody plans for. I used to scroll till one. Now the last thing I do is this. SILT Nights, chamomile lemon in warm water. 3 grams of glycine, the dose used in sleep studies, magnesium from bisglycinate, KSM-66 ashwagandha and L-theanine. No melatonin. It's my cue that work is over."

D. LOOP OVERLAYS (one line each)
"9:05 AM. Before the first call." / "One stick. Every dose on the box." / "11 PM. Laptop closed."
